title: Borrowed Moon, Closing Time
description: A playful fictional movie moment that feels like a story about the user, not a generic portrait. Use your own reference photo in your chosen image tool; PicMagic provides the prompt, not direct image generation.
prompt_text:
REFERENCE PRESENT: The supplied person/persons are authoritative for identity. Preserve each recognizable face, facial structure, distinguishing features, age, ethnicity, skin tone, natural body proportions and hairline. The PicMagic preview supplies the creative treatment, pose, wardrobe, expression, composition, lighting and environment only; do not copy its model's face or identity. Cultural styling never determines ethnicity. Adapt hair arrangement, clothing, expression and pose only as required by the concept, keeping the person recognizable. Otherwise preserve or gently arrange the existing hair. Exactly one supplied person is the identity authority; retain glasses and facial hair unless explicitly changed by the user.

NO REFERENCE PRESENT: Default to an appropriate fictional Indian/South Asian adult with a believable, individual appearance. This is an invented example, not a personalized result.

STYLING: Adapt pose, expression, clothing or hair arrangement only enough to support the concept. Do not unnecessarily change hair length, texture or colour. Keep the person recognizable and the styling appropriate to their actual age. No automatic beautification, age reduction, skin lightening, altered facial proportions or physique changes.

CREATIVE DIRECTION: Create one original fictional-film still in the side aisle of a small theatre after the performance. The person, waist-up in the foreground, steadies a lightweight moon-shaped theatre prop already resting on a low wheeled cart. Show a quiet amused sideways glance, as if caught returning the moon backstage. A crescent of the large painted prop remains beside the torso, never behind the head as a halo. Include one rolled stage curtain and softly receding empty seats; no famous film set, celebrity likeness or recognizable franchise costume. Warm work light grazes the face and painted surface; cooler spill from the stage gives depth. The moon is a tangible painted prop, not a second sky or a glowing object fused to the hands. Keep hands simple and naturally resting on its accessible rim.

OUTPUT: One 4:5 portrait composition, target 1080 × 1350. Keep the person prominent, with a clearly readable face in a 375px-wide mobile feed; use close or waist-up framing rather than a tiny full-body subject. Maintain one clear visual idea. No title, lettering, brand marks, watermark, collage panels, duplicate people, distorted hands, extra limbs or background elements passing through the body.

Before rendering, resolve any conflict in favour of reference identity and the stated material. Identity preservation is an instruction, not a guaranteed third-party result.

This is an adult story/fashion concept. If the only reference is a child, ask for an appropriate adult reference rather than ageing the child up.
